Occurrences.Kwic: 皆從胸中流出，稱性而談，所謂言與心親、行與道合，非世人揣摩摹擬之辭翰，與浮言過實者所可比也。有能讀此集，知其意句嚗嚗落處，則亦可從此悟入心性之密，恩逾父母矣。法乳所流，寧有窮哉？重刻證道歌註頌序重刻證道歌註頌序還丹一粒，點銕成金；至理一言，轉凡成聖。此惟吾宗門足以當之，故予嘗令學人熟讀寶誌公《十二時歌》、傅大士《心王銘》、三祖《信心銘》、永嘉《證道歌》、石頭《參同契》、雲巖《寶鏡三昧》諸著作，參研久之，自能隨事觸機，頓入圓明玅性。何則？此諸祖如大醫王，從曠劫來遍採奇異方藥，修煉微玅靈

Senses.Explanation: Turning the ordinary into the sage names an advertised transforming power that masters can affirm, question, or refuse in order to cut off the ordinary/holy split itself. Longmen compares one true word turning ordinary into sage with an elixir turning iron to gold. A formal address says the final mechanism can turn the ordinary into the sage. After a fire leaves everything empty, Zhenjing asks who it is that turns ordinary into sage. When the questioner asks to be transformed, Cuiyan refuses to “dot” him lest he fall into ordinary and sage.
